evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.147 Torr with Ar at 100.2 sccm near the growth temperature.
Growth pressure rose to 3.276 Torr despite temperature settling at 749.1 C and Ar at 100.2 sccm.
Pressure has risen monotonically during growth to 3.526 Torr while temperature is 750.3 C and Ar is 99.8 sccm, indicating pressure drift not explained by these setpoints.
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed; atmospheric purity cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth pressure profile and pressure tolerance; independent atmosphere or leak measurement and exhaust/pumping conductance checks to distinguish leakage, exhaust restriction, and other pressure causes; sample characterization to assess growth.
